display_long_description:
🐰 **WELCOME TO THE RABBIT!** 🦊

This is a survival horror game where 9 rabbits have to survive against 1 fox.

Each round lasts 6 minutes, and the fox is trying to catch every rabbit before the timer runs out. As a rabbit, you’ll have to explore the map, collect carrots, find burrows to hide in, and try not to get caught.

It sounds pretty simple, but things can get stressful really fast when you realize the fox is right behind you.

### 🥕 CARROTS

Carrots are scattered around the map and are useful for both rabbits and the fox.

If you’re a rabbit, eating a carrot gives you a speed boost for **8 seconds**. This can help you get away from the fox, reach a burrow, or just get around the map faster.

You can also collect carrots and put them into your storage during the round.

There is one important thing to remember, though:

**You can only sell your stored carrots if you survive the round.**

So if you collect a bunch of carrots and then get caught by the fox, you won’t be able to sell those carrots.

This means you have to decide how much you want to explore and how much you want to focus on staying safe.

The fox can eat carrots too, but instead of getting a speed boost, the fox gets a different ability.

When the fox eats a carrot, it can **see rabbits through walls for 7 seconds**.

If you're hiding somewhere and the fox uses this ability, it might be time to start moving.

### 🕳️ BURROWS

Burrows can be found around the map and are one of the main ways rabbits can hide
